knowledgeAnswers.rationale: VBA note (2018), definitions: barrier height is measured at right angles to the settled ground surface.
VBA note (2018), adjoining properties section: a boundary fence must reach at least 1800 mm on the pool side, with a zone measured 900 mm down.
VBA note (2018), mesh section: openings above 13 mm and up to 100 mm need at least 1800 mm of height.

practicalCriteria: On a supplied barrier section, measures height from the ground surface and states whether it meets the rule for internal or boundary barriers.
Measures mesh openings and the bottom gap on a supplied sample, and states whether each meets the rule.
Identifies a supplied ledge or step that affects the zone and states the correction required.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Barrier measurement record for the assessed section
stopWorkCriteria: Any gap under the barrier wider than 100 mm, or a climbable barrier next to the water: halt, secure the area, and report.
Change made to a permanent barrier without a permit: stop and report to the building surveyor.
Mesh opening above 100 mm: do not accept the barrier as compliant.
